name: app-white-subscription-history-and-pricing-screens-with-metal-bar-and-sky
title: Subscription History, Insights and Pro Plan Board
whatItIs: A white board with a tilted history screen resting on a chrome bar, a hand-held insights screen with an orange gauge, and a sky photo tile with a Pro Plan pricing sheet and a gummy star.
whatItMeans: A chrome prop and a sky photo add surprise to clean white screens, and pricing is presented as a friendly card.
techniques: Chrome bar as a prop for the phone
Sky and cloud photo behind the pricing card
Segmented orange gauge as signature graphic
Black header on the pricing card

vocabulary.definition: A shiny metal object used as a scene element.
A card listing a plan's price and features.
A device rotated to add dynamism.
